text.p: Alusuisse-Lonza Holding AG said it had combined various group enterprises active in the automobile sector into a single market organisation.
"The automotive market represents a focal point in the strategy of the aluminium division (Aluisusse)," it said in a statement.

The move affects the product lines of five different enterprises: Alusuisse Schweizerische Aluminium AG, Alusuisse Singen GmbH, Alusuisse Bayrisches Druckguss-Werk Gmbh & Co KG, Alusuisse Airex AG and Alusuisse Kapa GmbH Leichtstofftechnik.
The five produce semi-finished products and components for other industrial markets as well and are part of the group's aluminium division.
